---
title: "Getting Started"
---

## Installation

```bash
pip install tinylib
```

## First Steps

Import and use TinyLib in your project:

```python
from tinylib import process, analyze

# Process input data
result = process("input_data")

# Analyze results
analysis = analyze(result)
print(analysis)
```

## Configuration

TinyLib supports the following configuration options:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `verbose` | bool | False | Enable detailed logging |
| `timeout` | int | 30 | Operation timeout in seconds |
| `retries` | int | 3 | Number of retry attempts |
